responsibility: Declares the command-line target options for the MCore backend and maps them onto target masks or variables used by the rest of the port. It defines CPU selection, endianness, function alignment, divide and hard-literal generation, relaxed immediate handling, byte-access preference, callgraph-data emission, simulator-link suppression, stack probing increment, and bitfield treatment options, providing the option table consumed by GCC’s generated option-processing code and checked by mcore.h/mcore.cc.
same_name_distinction: Option-definition file for the MCore port: it lists target-specific command-line switches and maps them to masks or variables consumed by the rest of the backend, rather than implementing code as in mcore.cc, defining target macros in mcore.h, or describing RTL instructions in mcore.md.
